_text:
Suvarna Projects Limited
Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN
No. CC/46/2019/028
Dated: March 31, 2026
CertifiCate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Rigid Pavement — Delhi Pkg-28” (roads highways), awarded
to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
completed in all respects on May 19, 2019 at a gross executed value of INR 13.02 Cr (Rupees
13.02 Crore Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Sunita Joshi. This certificate is issued for
record and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish
past performance.
Executive Engineer
Suvarna Projects Limited
